title: Ursodeoxycolic acid for the prevention of relapsing complications after gallstone acute pancreatitis, a double-blind multicenter randomized-controlled trial.
official: Ursodeoxycolic acid for the prevention of relapsing complications after gallstone acute pancreatitis, a double-blind multicenter randomized-controlled trial.
summary: Main objective: To assess the incidence during follow-up of patients who have had a first episode of PAB, of the main variable of the study: death or complication associated with gallstones (acute pancreatitis, biliary colic, cholecystitis, cholangitis or choledocholithiasis), until have cholecystectomy performed or up to one year after the initial PAB.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Adulthood (18 years or older)
2. Income from PAB (will meet conditions 1 and 2):           1. Diagnosis of acute pancreatitis, at least 2 of the following 3 criteria (2)                        i) Acute abdominal pain in upper hemiabdomen or mesogastrium                        ii) Amylasemia or lipasemia greater than 3 times the upper limit of normal                        iii) Imaging test compatible with acute pancreatitis          2. Diagnosis of biliary etiology: cholelithiasis, microlithiasis or gallbladder sludge diagnosed by ultrasound, CT, MRI or endoscopic ultrasound.
3. Signature of the informed consent.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Endoscopic cholecystectomy and / or sphincterotomy prior to recruitment
2. Hypertriglyceridemia greater than 400 mg / dL during admission or a history of poorly controlled severe hypertriglyceridemia.
3. Chronic pancreatitis (pancreatic calcifications and / or Wirsung duct of 4 or more mm)
4. Pancreatic cystic lesions not attributed to the PAB itself
5. Wirsung duct stenosis.
6. Primary hyperparathyroidism
7. Pregnancy
8. Recurrent acute pancreatitis (1 or more previous episodes of pancreatitis of any origin)
9. Current waiting list at your center for cholecystectomy for PAB less than 30 days
10. Randomization more than 3 days after discharge from hospital for PAB
11. UDCA consumption in the last 5 years
12. Allergy, intolerance or presence of contraindications to UDCA (contraindicated in patients with gastric or duodenal ulcer, liver or intestinal disorders that interfere with the enterohepatic circulation of bile salts and lactation).
13. Presence of choledocholithiasis diagnosed by imaging tests prior to randomization.
14. Active alcoholism greater than or equal to 5 alcoholic drinks per day or high clinical suspicion of clinically significant alcoholism
15. Recent history of significant therapeutic non-compliance or social problem that makes follow-up difficult
